projects.name: PenSuite
projects.alt: Layered mint-green sheets etched with fine parallel lines
projects.summary: PenSuite is being developed as a creative workspace where interface design, interaction states and the decisions behind them belong together.
blocks: The product
An interface is more than a finished screen. PenSuite’s direction brings the canvas, the behavior and the reason for a design decision into one workspace.
What we are building toward
A place to shape a flow, explore its states and carry the important decisions into implementation. The aim is to make design intent understandable to the person building the product.
The standard
A beautiful screen must also explain how it behaves. Empty states, error states and the transitions between them deserve the same care as the first impression.
projects.headline: Give the idea a shape.
projects.description: A creative workspace for turning ideas into interfaces with intent.

projects.name: Pencore
projects.alt: Copper filaments wrapped around an interlocking trefoil knot
projects.summary: Pencore is being built to connect Android, web and API security research with reproducible evidence, keeping the path from attack surface to a defensible finding intact.
blocks: The product

Security research crosses boundaries: an Android package, a browser identity, a session, an API permission. Pencore’s focus is to connect those observations into investigations that explain the root cause and impact.
What we are building toward

An integrated research workflow spanning scoped discovery, controlled execution, role and session comparison, and evidence-backed findings. The researcher retains control of the final report and submission.
The standard
A finding must identify the affected artifact, preserve the reproduction and explain the impact. Broad offensive coverage matters; so does the ability to stand behind every result.
projects.headline:
Find the weakness.
Keep the proof.
projects.description: Offensive security intelligence. From attack surface to defensible evidence.

projects.name: Cortex 7.2
projects.alt: A violet wireframe sphere with sculpted, undulating ridges
projects.summary: Cortex 7.2 is a multi-model engineering agent in development, designed to carry a request through reasoning, code changes and checks that can be examined.
blocks: The product
The engineering task is larger than generating code. Cortex 7.2’s direction connects the original intent, the constraints, the implementation and the evidence of what actually ran.
What we are building toward

A deliberate engineering workflow: understand the request, reason about the change, execute the relevant checks and make unresolved questions visible. A longer-term HMOS research direction explores an independently trained scientific coding model.
The standard
A convincing answer is not a verified result. The work should expose its assumptions and distinguish a successful check from a claim that still needs evidence.
projects.headline:
Reason deeply.
Build deliberately.
projects.description: A multi-model engineering agent connecting intent, code and verification.

brief.name: The Ideolect perspective
brief.summary: We are building software for three demanding kinds of work: shaping an interface, investigating its security and engineering the systems behind it.
blocks: One company. Three disciplines.

PenSuite explores the creative workspace. Pencore develops security intelligence. Cortex 7.2 explores multi-model engineering. Each product has a distinct purpose, with a shared commitment to clear intent and inspectable work.
Depth is the direction

We believe the details that make software useful are also the details that make it trustworthy: an interaction state, a preserved reproduction, a test that can be rerun. The ambition is to give those details a proper home.
Built from India
Ideolect is an independent software company founded by Mahammadali Palsaniya. Our products are in development. This brief describes their direction and the standards guiding the work.
